dedupe_keys.name: residential ev charging datasets from apartment buildings risvollan trondheim 6 878 charging sessions by 97 users hourly synthetic loads garage smart meter and traffic data dec 2018 to jan 2020

description: This dataset describes real electric vehicle charging in apartment building garages at the Risvollan housing cooperative in Trondheim, Norway, and was published in 2021 with a Data in Brief article. The article read on 2026-09-28 describes charging reports for 6,878 sessions by 97 users from December 2018 to January 2020, each with plug-in and plug-out times and energy charged; synthetic hourly charging loads assuming 3.6 or 7.2 kilowatt charging, with the idle plugged-in capacity that measures flexibility, per user and aggregated for private and shared charge points; hourly smart meter data for one garage holding a third of the sessions; and hourly traffic counts at five nearby locations. The CSV files are deposited on Mendeley Data, and the data came from the charge point operator and the grid company with the cooperative's consent. Coverage is one housing cooperative in Trondheim. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (Mendeley Data record). Caveats: synthetic loads rest on assumed charging power and immediate charging, and one site in a cold, high-EV country may not transfer elsewhere. It supports capacity planning and flexibility studies, such as sizing garage connections or testing smart charging schedules for apartment blocks. Related records: the COFACTOR Risvollan residential energy data and US DOE EV charging data.
